recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the FHIR-21642 application by aligning the generated StructureMap element definitions with the approved `let` constants feature without reopening the later FHIR-43178 evaluation clarification.
issue_request: FHIR-21642 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core mapping-language change request for R5. It asked for reusable constants in mapping files; the approved resolution chose a top-level `let` statement whose value may be a constant or an expression using other constants.
initial_application: Commit cfe0c27ccf77885830ace90028056c9567b969d1 added a Constants section to source/mapping-language.html and added StructureMap.const, StructureMap.const.name, and StructureMap.const.value to source/structuremap/structuredefinition-StructureMap.xml. That application left StructureMap.const.name with a copied import definition and left StructureMap.const.value describing a variable with a misspelled short description.
additional_context: source/mapping-language.html is active in source/hierarchy.xml, and StructureMap is active in source/fhir.ini. The later FHIR-43178 clarification changed only constants evaluation/context wording and is already represented on the combined branch. Focused Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no conflicting community decision for FHIR-21642.
reconciliation: Updated source/structuremap/structuredefinition-StructureMap.xml so StructureMap.const.name defines the name used to refer to a mapping-language constant, and StructureMap.const.value consistently describes a FHIRPath expression value for the constant. No grammar, cardinality, or mapping-language-page behavior was changed.
source_changes: source/structuremap/structuredefinition-StructureMap.xml: corrected StructureMap.const.name from the copied import definition to a mapping-language constant-name definition.
source/structuremap/structuredefinition-StructureMap.xml: corrected StructureMap.const.value wording to say FHIRPath expression and value of this constant.
